answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on 18 tasks over 17 publicly available SLU datasets spanning 9 languages and 12 task types, including 10 classification task types (IC, speech command recognition (SCR), language identification (LID), fake speech detection (FSD), emotion recognition (ER), accent classification (AcC), sarcasm detection (SD), gender identification (GID), voice activity detection (VAD), and audio classification (AuC)) as well as 2 sequence generation task types (named entity recognition (NER) and semantic parsing (SP)).
answer_1.outputs: sequence of (entity phrase, entity tag) pairs, sematic parse sequence

answer_2.quote: We adopt the evaluation metrics used in prior work.
